slides.text: I watched this whole corridor *get built*.
slides.caption: Rural North Carolina to everything you need, in about the time it takes to grow up here.

slides.title: Cary and Morrisville
slides.text: I grew up in both. So when I tell you a neighborhood changed, I am not reading it off a chart. I watched the Parkside complex go from dirt to a thriving shopping center.

slides.caption: Past downtown Cary, out to US 1 and 540. One of the best access points in the Triangle that still has room to grow.

slides.title: West Cary
bullets: One or two established neighborhoods, *then dozens*
International grocers, boutiques, *restaurants worth the drive*
Parks and arts that did not exist *twenty years ago*

slides.caption: Out of West Cary, down 55. I was the listing agent on the house they left. It had more than doubled between 2016 and 2024.

slides.title: What to check
bullets: Drive 55 at *7:40am*, not on a Sunday
Ask what is *approved but not built* near the lot
Check which *town line* you are actually inside

slides.text: I have talked to dozens of people weighing this exact move. Tell me which end of 55 you are looking at and I will help you find the place that fits.
